blocks.text: Check our Miss International 2026 live updates page to get the latest news and features Binibining Pilipinas Katrina Anne Johnson has kept the Philippines’ bid for another international crown alive as she advanced to the Top 20 of the Miss International 2026 pageant in Tokyo, Japan, on Wednesday, Nov. 25. Johnson was among the 20 delegates called during the competition’s first round of eliminations alongside the following: Miss Zambia, Miss Indonesia, Miss Czech Republic, Miss Mexico, Miss US Virgin Islands, Miss Nigeria, Miss United Kingdom, Miss Myanmar, Miss Puerto Rico, Miss Dominican Republic, Miss Tanzania, Miss Moldova, Miss India, Miss Vietnam, […]...
